_comment: Deterministic TEST-ONLY seed key. Client-authored checkpoint, not jointly accepted or backend-distributed. Existing crypto/profile/name fixtures unchanged.
_codec_vector_format: Each vector invokes decoder on input or a detached copy of valid[base]. Apply set entries [path,value] in order then remove paths. Paths are arrays of object keys/zero-based array indexes. Optional command is parsed and supplied as request context after command_set. accept means codec acceptance; error-* positives are valid closed Error envelopes, never successes. expect_path selects a decoded field. Raw vectors decode exact UTF-8 wire with an explicit accept boolean. decoded_fields lists [path,expected] checks BEFORE DTO parsing, required for accepted lexical forms and also for unsupported integral versions/per-field failures (wire decoding succeeds, DTO rejects). Missing decoded_fields on a rejection allows raw decoding itself to fail. The integer decoder is the production safe-integer primitive over -JS_SAFE_MAX..JS_SAFE_MAX. Python-only float-object refusals remain in Python tests, not contradictory raw vectors. list_vectors expand the decoder's valid row count times, replacing character_id with index+1 and GET publication_id with UUID(int=index,version=4); this keeps all other fields unchanged and avoids inflating the shared fixture.
